teaser: The gate agent calls final boarding and you are moving before the announcement finishes. Three weeks later the same decision sits untouched, turned over like a coin that refuses to land. A life path 1 wired like an ESTP can hold both of those at once, quick on the easy call and strangely slow on the one that actually matters. Whether that gap shows up at your own gate, in your own three weeks, is worth noticing before it closes.
